Which booking site listed the lowest prices for Baton Rouge hotels?

The study's count, before taxes and fees: in the September 30, 2026 snapshot, at 9 of the 15 Baton Rouge hotels with a price, the lowest-priced listing was 5% or more below the going rate. Sites with the lowest price there: KAYAK.com at 4, Booking.com at 1, Kiwi.com at 1, Super.com at 1, Traveluro at 1 and Vio.com at 1. These are the Baton Rouge rows of the study's per-hotel CSV (going_rate_usd and cheapest_usd, before taxes and fees).

On this page, all-in: with taxes and fees as the sites reported them (a resort or destination fee may be extra), at 11 of the 15 hotels listed below a site was 5% or more below the all-in going rate. At the other 4, no site was 5% or more below it. The two counts differ: at 2 of the hotels listed below, the all-in prices put the gap on the other side of the 5% line. Taxes and fees at Baton Rouge hotels

At the 14 hotels with both an all-in and a before-tax going rate, taxes and fees, as the booking sites reported them to Google Hotels, added a median of 17% ($18 a night) to the before-tax going rate: from 16% at Home2 Suites by Hilton Baton Rouge to 20% at The Cook Hotel and Conference Center at LSU. At 1 hotel no site reported a before-tax price, so its price is a listed price that may leave out resort or property fees. Our data does not split the gap into taxes and fees.
